data.text: kadence.guru on 0.8.0 (site d89caf7): facts re-measured against the package, reference from the release asset, the 0.7.0 and 0.8.0 changelog (0.7.0 had never reached the site), the prompt hook in the quickstart and agent page with captured output, OG cards on every blog and docs page, honest-status copy, and 13 links that had 404d since DEC-20 now naming DOC-N in the journal. The first Vercel build failed in next/font/google ('queries have exactly one entry') with no font, dependency or config change and a clean local clone green; the same commit redeployed without change and went Ready. Still owner-only: the Google and Bing verification keys and INDEXNOW_KEY in Vercel.
